propositions: Recursive conftest glob pattern tests/**/conftest.py in global_support caused all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest change, wasting 322.6 runner-minutes across 97 runs without loading unrelated fixtures.

Pytest only loads conftests in a test directory and its ancestors, never sibling fixture trees; runtime tracing identified exactly six loaded conftests: tests/conftest.py and five non-root ancestors, proving sibling changes should not invalidate unrelated shards.
Per-shard conftest support mapping must match the derived ancestor-conftest closure of each shard's configured test paths, validated by a fail-closed contract that detects missing or stale entries.
Changing an unrelated nested conftest (e.g., tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py) must select zero shards; each true ancestor conftest change must select exactly its dependent shards.
